start.title: [TODO:ar] Israel Demands a King
start.text:
[TODO:ar] The elders cry, "Give us a king!"
Samuel turns to the Lord in grief.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A king is given, not seized.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Trust Samuel to seek God's word

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The Lord answers in His time.

crown_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Wait on the Lord
crown_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Crowns of pride do not last.
Let God choose His king.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Trust Samuel to seek God's word

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Honor the Prophet
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Samuel speaks for the Lord.
Wait with him in silence.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Trust Samuel to seek God's word

warning.title: [TODO:ar] The Cost of a King
warning.text:
[TODO:ar] "He will take your sons and fields."
The people still cry for one.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His words are for you too.

shout_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Quiet Your Voice
shout_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Listen before you answer.
The prophet speaks for God.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You let his words sink deep.

walk_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Stay and Hear
walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] These words will shape your life.
Return and listen.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You step back to the circle.

lost_path.title: [TODO:ar] Father's Donkeys Are Lost
lost_path.text:
[TODO:ar] Days of searching, hills of dust.
A servant says, "There is a seer here."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Pay him only for the donkeys

giveup_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Press Onward
giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Your search is more than donkeys.
Go to the seer.

pay_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Greater Than Coin
pay_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] He has no need of your silver.
Go and hear his word.

anointing.title: [TODO:ar] Oil on Your Head
anointing.text:
[TODO:ar] Samuel pours oil and kisses you.
"The Lord has chosen you to lead."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A king kneels before God first.
[TODO:ar] Do not refuse what God gives.
[TODO:ar] The oil runs warm down your brow.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Bow First
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The crown is heavy with calling.
Receive it in humility.

reject_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Do Not Refuse
reject_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] God Himself anoints through Samuel.
Receive what is given.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your hands rest open at your side.

assembly.title: [TODO:ar] Tribes Gather at Mizpah
assembly.text:
[TODO:ar] Lots fall and your name is called.
The people search the camp.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] God will still bring you out.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Serve First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] A king of Israel serves the Lord.
Step forward humbly.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Found Among the Jars
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] They draw you out into the light.
Your calling cannot be hidden.

confirmation.title: [TODO:ar] "Long Live the King!"
confirmation.text:
[TODO:ar] The tribes shout and bow before you.
A new road opens at your feet.
